text:
maya: FYI — after the 04:00 deploy I'm not seeing p95/p99 lines on the latency console for prod routes (notably /v1/generate). Only the median line shows. Anyone oncall?

sre-bot: deploy 04:00 by kevin -> inference-api : SUCCESS :white_check_mark:

kevin: I noticed this right after the deploy. Service health is fine, traces look normal. Dashboard legend still lists p95/p99 but the graph is empty for those series.

devon: checking metrics pipeline — we rolled the new collector across clusters at ~03:58. Will validate label formats.

analytics: pulled the raw series from TSDB — p95/p99 exist but their `quantile` label looks different. Old collector emitted `quantile="0.95"`, new one emits `quantile="95"` (no decimal). Dashboard queries expect the string form. That mismatch would hide the series.

maya: can you paste the dashboard's query?

analytics: the panel uses a label matcher like `quantile='0.95'` in grafana/flux. Example query we run: 
```sql
SELECT quantile(0.95) AS p95 FROM latency_metrics WHERE route='/v1/generate' AND env='prod' GROUP BY time(1m)
```
But the backing series labels are now `quantile=95`.

kevin: ugh. PR #782 changed quantile to int for compactness. It must have slipped through. I'm going to revert the collector change.

devon: as a quicker mitigation I can update the dashboard panel matcher to accept both formats (coerce or match `quantile in ('0.95','95')`) so we restore visibility immediately. Then we can revert collector and normalize. I can do the dashboard patch in ~15m.

olga: Customer-facing ticket #1234 reporting missing latency tails — they want an ETA before 09:00 PDT.

maya: please keep me in the loop, I'll update the customer once we have partial fix.

kevin: also worth adding an alert if p95/p99 series drop to zero across routes — would catch this earlier.

devon: quick plan: 1) patch dashboard panel to accept both labels (hotfix) 2) revert collector label change and add a transform to ensure string quantile 3) follow-up backfill/aliasing for duplicated series window. Rolling step 1 now.

sre-bot: oncall: kevin (rotation) notified.

devon: patched dashboards, queries now match `quantile in ('0.95','95')`. Deployed at 1805012567.

analytics: I can confirm p95/p99 lines are rendering again in grafana for PROD. There is a short window (~20m) where both series (string and int label) show up; I collapsed duplicates in the view.

olga: updated customer — they say charts look normal now, will monitor.

kevin: opening follow-up ticket to: revert collector PR, add integration test for label formats, and add alert for missing quantiles.

maya: awesome. Closing loop: PROD latency dashboard restored, customer notified. Follow-ups assigned to kevin/devon/analytics for cleanup. Closing thread.
